candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (and /readyz), causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 propagating through order to gateway; payment logs confirm 503s on /v1/authorizations and /readyz.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503 root cause (config, dependency, crash) not established; payment metrics excluded from context. Inventory/redis path succeeded, so not the failing hop.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; order propagates the failure to gateway. Inventory reservations succeed. Bounded to payment-side 5xx as the failing hop; underlying payment fault unconfirmed.
